audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Fear, war, sanctuary, beauty, abandonment by parents, false witnesses, and patient courage.

verses.restored: The YHWH is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the YHWH is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

familiar.text: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

modern.text: The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?

original.text: לְדָוִ֨ד יְהוָ֤ה אוֹרִ֣י וְ֭יִשְׁעִי מִמִּ֣י אִירָ֑א יְהוָ֥ה מָֽעוֹז חַ֝יַּ֗י מִמִּ֥י אֶפְחָֽד

verses.restored: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

familiar.text: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

modern.text: When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh, my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.

original.text: בִּקְרֹ֤ב עָלַ֨י מְרֵעִים֮ לֶאֱכֹ֪ל אֶת בְּשָׂ֫רִ֥י צָרַ֣י וְאֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י הֵ֖מָּה כָשְׁל֣וּ וְנָפָֽלוּ

verses.restored: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

familiar.text: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

modern.text: Though an army encamps around me, my heart will not fear; though a war breaks out against me, I will keep my trust.

original.text: אִם תַּחֲנֶ֬ה עָלַ֨י מַחֲנֶה֮ לֹֽא יִירָ֪א לִ֫בִּ֥י אִם תָּק֣וּם עָ֭לַי מִלְחָמָ֑ה בְּ֝זֹ֗את אֲנִ֣י בוֹטֵֽחַ

verses.restored: One thing have I desired of the YHWH, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the YHWH all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the YHWH, and to enquire in his temple.

familiar.text: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.

modern.text: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.

original.text: אַחַ֤ת שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵֽאֵת יְהוָה֮ אוֹתָ֪הּ אֲבַ֫קֵּ֥שׁ שִׁבְתִּ֣י בְּבֵית יְ֭הוָה כָּל יְמֵ֣י חַיַּ֑י לַחֲז֥וֹת בְּנֹֽעַם יְ֝הוָ֗ה וּלְבַקֵּ֥ר בְּהֵיכָלֽוֹ

verses.restored: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

familiar.text: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

modern.text: For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.

original.text: כִּ֤י יִצְפְּנֵ֨נִי בְּסֻכֹּה֮ בְּי֪וֹם רָ֫עָ֥ה יַ֭סְתִּרֵנִי בְּסֵ֣תֶר אָהֳל֑וֹ בְּ֝צ֗וּר יְרוֹמְמֵֽנִי

verses.restored: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the YHWH.

familiar.text: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.

modern.text: Then my head will be held high above my enemies around me. At His tabernacle I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.

original.text: וְעַתָּ֨ה יָר֪וּם רֹאשִׁ֡י עַ֤ל אֹֽיְבַ֬י סְֽבִיבוֹתַ֗י וְאֶזְבְּחָ֣ה בְ֭אָהֳלוֹ זִבְחֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Hear, O YHWH, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

familiar.text: Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

modern.text: Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call; be merciful and answer me.

original.text: שְׁמַע יְהוָ֖ה קוֹלִ֥י אֶקְרָ֗א וְחָנֵּ֥נִי וַעֲנֵֽנִי

verses.restored: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, YHWH, will I seek.

familiar.text: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.

modern.text: My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.

original.text: לְךָ֤ אָמַ֣ר לִ֭בִּי בַּקְּשׁ֣וּ פָנָ֑י אֶת פָּנֶ֖יךָ יְהוָ֣ה אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ

verses.restored: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

familiar.text: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

modern.text: Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.

original.text: אַל תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ מִמֶּנִּי֮ אַֽל תַּט בְּאַ֗ף עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ עֶזְרָתִ֥י הָיִ֑יתָ אַֽל תִּטְּשֵׁ֥נִי וְאַל תַּֽ֝עַזְבֵ֗נִי אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי

verses.restored: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the YHWH will take me up.

familiar.text: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

modern.text: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.

original.text: כִּי אָבִ֣י וְאִמִּ֣י עֲזָב֑וּנִי וַֽיהוָ֣ה יַֽאַסְפֵֽנִי

verses.restored: Teach me thy way, O YHWH, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

familiar.text: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

modern.text: Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.

original.text: ה֤וֹרֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֗ה דַּ֫רְכֶּ֥ךָ וּ֭נְחֵנִי בְּאֹ֣רַח מִישׁ֑וֹר לְ֝מַ֗עַן שׁוֹרְרָֽי

verses.restored: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

familiar.text: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

modern.text: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.

original.text: אַֽל תִּ֭תְּנֵנִי בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ צָרָ֑י כִּ֥י קָֽמוּ בִ֥י עֵֽדֵי שֶׁ֝֗קֶר וִיפֵ֥חַ חָמָֽס

verses.restored: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the YHWH in the land of the living.

familiar.text: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

modern.text: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

original.text: לׅׄוּלֵׅׄ֗אׅׄ הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי לִרְא֥וֹת בְּֽטוּב יְהוָ֗ה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּֽים

verses.restored: Wait on the YHWH: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the YHWH.

familiar.text: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

modern.text: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!

original.text: קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל יְה֫וָ֥ה חֲ֭זַק וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל יְהוָֽה

translation_notes: This chapter expands corpus coverage while remaining explicitly pending a deeper Hebrew/source-witness audit. KJV is retained only as the familiar comparison layer.

The completion draft intentionally preserves coherent traditional English syntax where a verse has not yet received a curated Hebrew-sensitive rendering; it does not mix archaic and modern grammar. Major identified lexical/textual issues receive explicit overrides and notes.
safety_note: The psalm does not guarantee family acceptance, military victory, or immediate rescue; people abandoned by family deserve concrete human support as well as spiritual comfort.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Scrolls where extant, and other relevant witnesses during the global audit.
Preserve Psalm numbering and superscription differences across Hebrew and Greek traditions rather than silently harmonizing them.
